text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock by its prospects and its role in my overall portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price.","Selling a small gain felt satisfying, but avoiding the pain of realizing a loss can keep me invested too long; I should use consistent decision rules for gains and losses.","My account fell substantially while I made no trades. Since past price moves do not predict future ones, I should review my holdings deliberately rather than assume waiting or frequent checking will improve outcomes."]}
